164:3241.en: 「This is my way... the $$ハイアデス$$ way!」

g164.basis: Introduces himself as Dabalan Tau (164:0), serves Eluna and Straus, flies Adoratio; differs from Jigoku (Suzaku)

uncertain: 生き様 (way of living) rendered 'way' to fit; speaker token $$ダバラーン$$ as in story speaker lines (glossary also has $$ダバラーン・タウ$$)
